searchText: https://ethpandaops.io/posts/hoodi-attestation-packing/ Posted my analysis of attestation packing on hoodi before/after Electra here 🙏 We're rebalancing some more keys and adding prysm/teku to the mix. Ill update details on timeframes once its done. 100k-200k: moved to prysm stopped @ 1743605289 (hoodi slot 115992), started @ 1743607282(hoodi slot 116147) 200k-275k: moved to teku stopped 1743607505 @ (hoodi slot 116173), started @ 1743608816(hoodi slot 116282) Do you see the change to attestation inclusion or other metrics after the migration? What's the average miss slot rate in Mainnet recently? Not really, and network level metrics also look similar Sam is asleep and could expand on it more, but it seems like this PR i deployed didn't really help nimbus: https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth2/pull/7043 (epoch basically tracks before and after we deployed it) Current working theory is that nimbus having issues in inclusion is tanking the other per client inclusion rates. But this is still a naieve reading, no explanation as to how or if the reading is even fully correct.
